subtitle: Published gatherings from Swift Ahmedabad’s Talks archive and Luma listings. Browse Luma for new announcements.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad WWDC26 Watch Party
events.description: The community came together to watch Apple's WWDC keynote and discuss the announcements.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad March’26 Meetup
events.description: Talks explored AI in iOS apps, Figma Code Connect, and reliable connected-device apps with Swift and BLE.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad December’25 Meetup
events.description: Sessions covered Instruments and performance tuning, Vapor, Foundation Models, accessibility, and a showcase from LJ University.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad October’25 Meetup
events.description: The community shared experiences from Swift Bharat, approaches to code quality, and lessons on building connections.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad July’25 Meetup
events.description: A session on Xcode 26 and ChatGPT, followed by IndeHub project demos.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad WWDC25 Watch Party
events.description: The WWDC25 gathering included “Introduction to Keynote” and “Lessons from Launching My First App Linnk”.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad April’25 Meetup
events.description: Talks explored physics in AR, design patterns, and SOLID principles, with time for networking.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad February’25 Meetup
events.description: Talks covered Swift Testing, code signing and reverse engineering, Image Playground, modular apps, and the vocabulary of TCA.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad December’24 Meetup
events.description: Sessions explored SwiftData, indie development, iOS 18 Control Widgets, and dependency injection with Live Activities.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad October’24 Meetup
events.description: Talks covered Mesh, a plug-and-play UI framework, modern concurrency, and Apple Intelligence.

events.title: Swift Ahmedabad August’24 Meetup
